meta.description: SANSA.Query evaluator coverage over host-neutral binding fixtures.

tests.description: Evaluator filters candidate bindings and projects scalar fields.
Evaluator applies offset and limit after filtering.
Evaluator applies stable order by before offset and limit.

input.source:
from $.inventory.items.*
order by .qty desc
offset 1
limit 2
select .sku

tests.description: Where expressions must evaluate to Boolean true or false.
The evaluator rejects unsupported function calls explicitly.
The evaluator supports any over a resolved binding-set predicate.
all(empty) evaluates to true.
none(empty) evaluates to true.
Built-in contains may be used as a Boolean filter expression.
exists returns true when the resolution expression resolves one or more bindings.
exists on a container combined with absent on its expansion selects present empty containers.

input.source:
from $.inventory.items.*
where exists(.roles) and absent(.roles.*)
select .sku

tests.description: absent returns true when the resolution expression resolves zero bindings.
isNullReason tests explicit null values without matching missing bindings.

input.source:
from $.inventory.items.*
where exists(.status) and isNullReason(.status, "notSet")
select .sku

tests.description: absent tests missing bindings and does not match explicit null values.
isNull is a scalar value test and reports missing when its operand resolves no bindings.
isValue matches ordinary scalar values.
isValue returns false, rather than a missing diagnostic, when its operand resolves no bindings.
isValue excludes NaN and infinity while accepting ordinary finite numbers.

input.source:
from $.inventory.items.*
where isValue(.metric) or isValue(.ceiling)
select .sku

tests.description: isValue requires a single binding when its operand is present.
isValue accepts ordinary scalar expression results, including literals.
isNaN tests explicit NaN values without relying on equality comparison.

input.source:
from $.inventory.items.*
where exists(.metric) and isNaN(.metric)
select .sku

tests.description: isInfinity tests explicit Infinity values.

input.source:
from $.inventory.items.*
where exists(.ceiling) and isInfinity(.ceiling)
select .sku

tests.description: Built-in string functions may be used inside projection fields.
Built-in string functions include suffix checks.
path activates a structured contextual SANSA Address Literal value in select expressions.
path may be used in where, order by, and projection expressions.

input.source:
from $.inventory.items.*
where path($.<"params">.active) == false
order by path($.<"params">.sort) desc
select { sku = path($.<"params">.field) qty = .qty }

tests.description: path rejects plain strings that look like addresses.

Membership tests a scalar value against the scalar values exposed by a Binding Set.
Membership over an empty or non-matching Binding Set evaluates to false and may be negated.

Membership over an empty Binding Set evaluates to false.

Membership consumes the left operand in scalar context, so multiple left bindings fail.

Membership uses equality comparison rules, so NaN candidates are not comparable by default.
Membership uses equality comparison rules, so infinity may compare as a numeric bound when supported.

lookup requires the key to resolve exactly one scalar value.
lookup rejects key types outside string member names and non-negative integer positions.
